display_title: My Path Is to Become a Developer
description:
[Beta Top Ji Yubin X Alpha Bottom Lee Taeseong]

Lee Taeseong, the grandson of pharmaceutical company N and a perfect alpha, had given up his wild lifestyle and planned to live quietly after a fight over management rights. But his plans get messed up when he meets Beta Ji Yubin.

*"I told you I'm making a game... I think I could develop other things too. Would you invest just once?"*

What am I supposed to do about this kid who wants to bed an alpha?
